entities.summary: Naomi Fontaine is a Canadian writer from Quebec, noted as one of the most prominent First Nations writers in contemporary francophone Canadian literature. She is a member of the Innu nation. Naomi Fontaine was a authors & novelists from Uashat (b. 1987-09-29, Uashat). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
